_what: The machine-readable twin of RECONSTRUCTION-CHARTER.md section 0 (Project lifecycle, user directive 2026-10-02). The charter section is the human authority; this file must say the same thing, and check_lifecycle_consumers.py fails when it does not. It is NOT a completion gate: whole-database MET/NOT_MET stays goal_gate.py's. Change it only with the charter section, in one reviewed publish.
sources: _index/_inbox/TEAM.md 'The endpoint is L1 + L2 completion, not the readiness gate' (2026-09-12)
phase_set_by: user directive; changes only by an explicit user instruction recorded in the charter section
bounded_probes_are: evidence instruments that test whether a database claim or contract is sufficient; they do not start the primary reconstruction campaign and pilot counts are not a completion score

phases.meaning: complete and certify L1 MODDING-GRADE + L2 RECONSTRUCTION-GRADE
goal_gate.py MET including the thirty-pass terminal certification; nothing further starts until the user authorizes
user-authorized primary reconstruction in independently authored maintainable source
reconstructed systems composed with their real dependencies
differential and live validation certified for declared dimensions
a whole-game high-parity reconstructed FFXII runtime

not_reconstruction: hidden fallback into the original binary
mass-translated decompiler output presented as understood source

on_disagreement: find the first divergence (earlier states compared), then correct the reconstruction, the evidence harness, the composition, or the canonical DB claim with evidence; DB corrections follow the correction/supersession policy and propagate to consumers

current_authorities.generated_status: Database/FFXII TZA/PROGRESS.md (generated by progress_report.py; never hand-edited)
